Shivam Epoxy Flooring · Surat

Strong foundations.
Personal attention.

Founded in 2025 by Shivam Vishwakarma, Shivam Epoxy Flooring provides industrial and commercial surface solutions from Surat, Gujarat.

From understanding your requirements to planning and supervising installation, our approach centres on workmanship, clear communication, and the right system for your site.

Our focus is industrial and commercial epoxy & PU flooring, with residential and decorative finishes, parking surfaces, and waterproofing also available.

Good questions. Clear answers.

Questions, answered.

Why compare more than the square-foot price?

We recommend a flooring or waterproofing system only after considering the surface, intended use and site conditions. A lower price may reflect a different scope, preparation or material specification. If the available budget does not support the necessary preparation and suitable system, we will explain the limitations, propose a suitable alternative where possible, or decline that scope rather than promise unsupported performance.

Which warranty applies to my project?

Warranty terms vary by site, coating system, surface condition, intended use, area, operating conditions and customer requirements. The accepted project quotation and matching warranty card state the final project-specific duration, start date, coverage, exclusions, maintenance requirements and claim process. Agree the terms in writing before payment or work begins. Website ranges are indicative, not a warranty for every project. Any inconsistency must be clarified and agreed in writing; a warranty card cannot unilaterally reduce an already agreed commitment. These documents do not override privacy/cookie commitments or mandatory legal rights.

What does Shivam Epoxy Flooring specialise in?

Our primary focus is industrial and commercial epoxy & PU flooring. We also provide residential and decorative flooring, parking and ramp surfaces, and tank, roof and swimming pool waterproofing.

Which flooring is suitable for a factory or warehouse?

That depends on the concrete condition, traffic, loads, impact, chemical exposure, and cleaning routine. We assess these requirements before recommending an epoxy or PU system and its specification.

Do you provide decorative flooring?

Yes. Decorative epoxy, metallic effects, and Italian-style flooring are part of our services. Discuss the desired appearance and confirm the finish and shade before installation.

Can you waterproof tanks, roofs, and swimming pools?

Yes. Tell us the surface type, leakage history, and intended use. Tanks and pools need systems suited to their specific use; the substrate, water exposure, and curing requirements guide the recommendation.

What warranty is available for waterproofing?

Waterproofing warranty: 2–10 years, depending on the surface, use, and site conditions. The applicable duration and terms are confirmed for your project.

Is food-grade flooring available?

Yes. Food-grade flooring solutions are available for food-processing areas, subject to verification of the specific product/system documentation. The specific system is selected for the use, cleaning, temperature, and applicable product documentation.

How is the quotation calculated?

Pricing depends on area, substrate condition, repairs and preparation, system thickness, materials, and site conditions. Contact +91 95698 37456 to discuss your site and request a quotation.

How long will installation and curing take?

The schedule depends on site preparation, project size, coating system, and conditions. We discuss installation and curing separately so you can plan when foot traffic, equipment, or water exposure can resume.

Where are you based?

We are based in Mahidharpura, Surat, Gujarat 395003. Share your project location by phone, WhatsApp, or email to discuss site inspection and service availability.
